About this design

Built from the supplied SketchUp model (gsquare.skp): an under-staircase wall about 12 feet wide. The 65-inch TV sits centred on a high-gloss, vertical-grain wood-mica back panel inside a 9 in deep matte wood-mica frame, with a warm LED shining down from the sloping top.

Below the TV: two matte wood-mica doors (outer hinges) and two aluminium-frame grey tinted glass doors (opening from the middle), all with small chrome-gold knobs, over a set-back skirting with a warm floor LED. Left: a fixed fluted column lit by a concealed LED strip. Right: two push-to-open storage doors, empty inside.

The pooja unit has CNC-cut doors in your pattern, in matte wood mica, with warm light glowing through the cut-outs, two drawers and lower storage with chrome-gold knobs. On the staircase side: a wash-basin niche behind the fluted column (mirror, basin counter, fixed box below), a glowing artificial-grass panel in a matte wood-mica border, a push-to-open storage door hinged on the staircase side, a small push-to-open door with a fixed triangle low on the stair-side wall, and matte wood-mica cladding on the stair.

Wood grain scale, panel thicknesses, knob positions, the CNC drawing, grass texture and light colours not specified are visual approximations. Source geometry is retained under Reference colours. Pricing has not been imported.
